sections.name: NotificationsModal
sections.title: Notification panel
sections.what: Draws nothing when closed. When open, lists each notification, marks it read on click, and offers Clear and close buttons, plus a message when the list is empty.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user see alerts without leaving the current page.
sections.watch_out: Clear removes every notification at once, with no confirmation and no undo.

summary: Panel that lists system notifications, marks each one read when clicked, and offers a Clear button.
purpose: Lets the user review and dismiss app alerts.
why: Likely reason: keeps alerts in one list the user can check. The reason for the placement is not stated in the code.
how: Reads the open flag, the notification list, and the actions from the store. Draws nothing when closed. When open, draws a panel at the top right with each notification's title, time, and message. Clicking marks it read. Clear empties the list. The close button hides the panel.
inputs: The notification list (title, message, time, read state) and the open flag from the store, plus clicks.
outputs: A panel listing notifications, read marks, a cleared list, or a message saying there are none.
risks: Clear removes every notification at once with no confirmation. The panel does not close when the user clicks outside it.
debug: If the list is always empty, check whether notifications are being added to the store. If the times look wrong, check the stored timestamp. If Clear does nothing, check the clear action in the store.
